name: @tormenta20/engine-go
description: Go API + rules engine. `dev` runs air (hot-reload of cmd/api :3001) reading .env.development; `build` compiles the production binary and `start` boots it with .env.production, serving the built SPA, the API and the socket from ONE process — that is the whole production stack, no nginx and no compose. The WASM is built by the frontend's predev/prebuild.
